_requirement_entries.description: Superheterodyne receiver (single or double IF) covering 300–1000 MHz with sub-band tuning via switched filter bank.
_requirement_entries.title: Receiver Architecture

_requirement_entries.description: The receiver shall operate across 300–1000 MHz (UHF band).
_requirement_entries.title: Frequency Range

_requirement_entries.description: Instantaneous bandwidth shall be 1–10 MHz.
_requirement_entries.title: Instantaneous Bandwidth

_requirement_entries.description: Minimum discernible signal shall be -100 dBm or better.
_requirement_entries.title: Sensitivity (MDS)

_requirement_entries.description: The receiver shall survive +20 dBm CW at the antenna port without damage.
_requirement_entries.title: Maximum Input Power

_requirement_entries.description: System noise figure shall be less than 2 dB.
_requirement_entries.title: System Noise Figure

_requirement_entries.description: Total system gain shall be 30 dB nominal.
_requirement_entries.title: System Gain

_requirement_entries.description: Input third-order intercept point shall be -10 dBm or better.
_requirement_entries.title: Input IP3

_requirement_entries.description: Input 1 dB compression point shall be -20 dBm or better.
_requirement_entries.title: Input P1dB

_requirement_entries.description: Image rejection shall exceed 50 dB across the tuning range.
_requirement_entries.title: Image Rejection

_requirement_entries.description: Local oscillator phase noise shall be -100 dBc/Hz at 10 kHz offset.
_requirement_entries.title: LO Phase Noise

_requirement_entries.description: Sub-band tuning via switched filter bank across the 300–1000 MHz range.
_requirement_entries.title: Tuning Method

_requirement_entries.description: Receiver shall process pulsed radar signals with 1 µs nominal pulse width.
_requirement_entries.title: Signal Type Support

_requirement_entries.description: Fully coherent operation required for pulse-Doppler and MTI processing.
_requirement_entries.title: Phase Coherence

_requirement_entries.description: Group delay variation shall be less than 1 ns across the instantaneous bandwidth.
_requirement_entries.title: Group Delay Variation

_requirement_entries.description: Receiver shall support coherent pulse-Doppler and MTI processing.
_requirement_entries.title: Coherent Processing Support

_requirement_entries.description: Receiver shall operate in the presence of strong adjacent and out-of-band blockers.
_requirement_entries.title: Blocker Handling

_requirement_entries.description: Analog baseband output (I/Q differential pair).
_requirement_entries.title: Output Type

_requirement_entries.description: 50 Ω output impedance with SMA connectors.
_requirement_entries.title: Output Impedance and Connector

_requirement_entries.description: Baseband output bandwidth shall support the 1–10 MHz instantaneous bandwidth requirement.
_requirement_entries.title: Baseband Bandwidth

_requirement_entries.description: Baseband output level 1 Vpp nominal (engineering default).
_requirement_entries.title: Output Signal Level

_requirement_entries.description: Primary supply voltage shall be +28V (MIL standard bus).
_requirement_entries.title: Power Supply

_requirement_entries.description: Total power consumption shall be 5–15 W.
_requirement_entries.title: Power Consumption

_requirement_entries.description: Internal PLL frequency reference with standard stability (engineering default).
_requirement_entries.title: Frequency Reference

_requirement_entries.description: Operating temperature range -40°C to +85°C (engineering default for military/defense application).
_requirement_entries.title: Operating Temperature

_requirement_entries.description: Conduction-cooled for military deployment (engineering default given +28V rail).
_requirement_entries.title: Cooling Method

_requirement_entries.description: SWaP-optimized module (engineering default for +28V defense application).
_requirement_entries.title: Form Factor

_requirement_entries.description: Design shall comply with MIL-STD-461 EMI and MIL-STD-810 environmental standards (engineering default for defense radar application).
_requirement_entries.title: Compliance
